description: Deterministic adversarial numeric-ingest and derivation corpus for the Distractor Derivation Model. Every incoming_numeric_token is preserved verbatim as text (never normalized/re-spelled) and every expected outcome is generated through the Go reference derive() and serialized with the canonical encoder. Rows are enumerated by a single stable counter (the `index` is the replay_identity), so regeneration is byte-identical. Replayed byte-for-byte by the Go reference (task 8.3), the Worker port (task 11.2), and the Functions port (task 10.4). Do not hand-edit; regenerate with GEN_DERIVATION_CORPUS=1 go test ./agent-go -run TestGenerateDerivationCorpus.
